title: Senior Python Developer
description:
We are looking for Senior Python developer for work in our worldwide team. We need a
developer who wants to take part in something big and assume responsibility for the success of a
new and innovative e-commerce project.
We are an all-in-one, leading dropshipping platform that automates all actions for the user, from
finding smart and hot-selling products to product uploading, price & stock monitoring the
suppliers’ sites, customer support system, price optimization system, and more.
The company is global and has teams all over the world. Teams vary in size and frequently
collaborate with each other, providing our employees the unique opportunity to learn and work
with teammates from around the world. Every employee plays a key role in growing the
company and has the responsibility for the success of the company.
What is required of you:
-Main hard skills requirements for candidates:
1. Strong background with Python 4+ years;
2. Experience with Python 3 version;
3. Experience working with background tasks using Celery
4. Strong background with DBs - MySQL and MongoDB;
5. Strong experience with Kubernetes and Docker;
6. Experience with AWS.
7. Managerial experience will be as a plus.
8. Experience with collaborative interface design tools like Figma – will be as a plus.
-Main soft skills requirements for candidates:
1. Strong desire and a proactive attitude to work;
2. Flexibility and team-player;
3. English - at least Intermediate level.
4. Strong problem-solving abilities
5. Ability to independently perform your tasks
Will be a plus:
Ability to work in a time zone close to the US is huge advantage.
Ready to offer:
Social benefits, paid vacations, sick-leaves;
Career possibilities with growing team;
Modern office;
Excellent Medical Insurance (health, dental, etc.);
Gym membership;
Onsite English classes for different levels and with different programs;
Presents from the company for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, and the birth of the child.
The right candidate will be someone with an open mind who loves to solve problems and who
strives to take their projects to the next level.
If you are interested in this position, please send us your CV!
About Global Teams
We are Global Teams, founded in 2014 to help you grow your business by drawing on the talents of dedicated IT professionals based in Ukraine.
We began as a software development outsourcing company, but quickly realized that remote work is the future. We added a curated outstaffing service, giving clients more control over their remote teams while reducing expenses and any administrative challenges they may encounter.
Today, Global Teams has expanded to include over 150 experienced software developers and other professionals in Ukraine, with offices in Kyiv, Ukraine, and Tel Aviv, Israel.
